This release contains internal maintenance only.


**Full changelog:** [v1.0.0...v1.0.1](https://github.com/RenardElectric/PolyCoin/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1)

## New features
- Adds a server-side economy with the default `polycoin` currency, `1000.00 ℗` starting balance, and an automatically created default account for each player.
- Adds player account commands to create, inspect, rename, select, transfer between, share with other owners, and delete accounts.
- Adds player payments with `/polycoin pay`, including optional source and destination accounts, plus `/balance` and `/pay` shortcuts.
- Adds currency commands for players to list and inspect currencies, and for Gamemasters to create, modify, select, and delete currencies.
- Adds `/balancetop` and `/baltop` leaderboards with configurable limits up to 100 accounts, currency statistics, and `/polycoin pnj` leaderboard mannequins with visible top-balance displays.
- Adds administrative balance changes and `/polycoin as` support for managing account, balance, and payment actions for online or offline players.
- Provides a registered Common Economy API provider for PolyCoin currencies and accounts, including custom default currency and account icons.

## Improvements
- Supports multiple account owners with shared balances, owner management, per-currency default accounts, exact two-decimal transactions, and atomic validation for transfers and balance changes.
- Persists currencies, accounts, balances, owners, and per-owner defaults as world data, and records successful economy changes in the server log.

## Compatibility
- Supports Minecraft `26.3` with Fabric Loader `0.19.5` or newer, Fabric API `0.161.0+26.3` or newer, and Java `25` or newer.
- PolyCoin is server-side; multiplayer clients do not need the PolyCoin JAR.
